summary: Sleep, relax and meditate with relaxing sounds of nature, rain or white noise.
description: Searching for relaxing sounds and ambience that will improve your sleep or relaxation? Search no more! Sleepa delivers an extensive collection of HD sounds that can be mixed into the perfect relaxing soundscape. Choose from rain, nature sounds, city sounds, white noise, instruments & more. Customize and save your favorite sound mixes to play at anytime. Schedule the sleep timer to automatically turn off your sound mix once you’re fast asleep. Sleepa does not require internet connection so you can use it anywhere without worrying about using data. Choose from 120+ carefully selected sounds from several categories: Rain sounds (rain on the window, ocean waves, thunderstorms) Nature sounds (forest leaves, creek, waterfall) City sounds (subway, train, fan, airplane) Meditation sounds (white noise, piano, wind flute) ASMR sounds (tapping, purring, clicking) Lullabies (harmonic, vocals) Activities (walking, skating) Holidays (New Year, Thanksgiving) Animals (birds, frogs) Take your listening experience to the next level! Dive into Sound Journeys—interactive soundscapes where you can explore evolving worlds and immersive stories. Your choices shape the path and your relaxing experience. Sleepa is perfect relaxation & sleep, meditation, or when you simply want to focus & concentrate, and features the most popular types of white noise: White noise Pink noise Brown noise Have questions or feedback? Email us at contact@maplemedia.io for fast & friendly support. Happy sleeping!
